content_sections.heading: APPSC Group A & Group B Vacancy 2026 – Post Details
content_sections.text: APPSC has advertised a total of 155 posts under this notification, of which 6 posts are reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD). Vacancy numbers are based on requisitions submitted by the indenting departments and may be revised by the Commission.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group A & Group B Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for this recruitment must satisfy all three mandatory eligibility conditions notified vide Government Notification F.No.AR-33/17/2026-SECT-1-AR dated 26th August 2026. Permanent Residence Criterion: Candidate must be a citizen of India and an inhabitant of Arunachal Pradesh holding a valid Permanent Residence Certificate (PRC). Indigenous Status and APST Criterion: Candidate must be an original inhabitant of Arunachal Pradesh and hold an Arunachal Pradesh Scheduled Tribe (APST) Certificate as per the list of Tribes notified under the Constitution (Scheduled Tribes) Order, 1950. Indigenous Tribal Language Proficiency Criterion: Candidate must be able to speak an Indigenous Tribal Language of Arunachal Pradesh and possess working knowledge of the local indigenous tribes, per the implementation mechanism notified by the Government. Candidates who have appeared or are appearing in the final semester of the qualifying course may also apply, but must submit proof of having passed the qualifying exam in original on or before the date of interview, failing which they will not be permitted to appear for the viva-voce.

rows.educational_qualification: Bachelor of Science in Agriculture from a recognized university
Bachelor of Science in Horticulture from a recognized university
Bachelor of Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry, with registration in the Arunachal Pradesh State Veterinary Council (mandatory at application or by document verification)
Bachelor's degree in Science with Post Graduate Diploma in Sericulture from a recognized university/institute

Bachelor of Technology in Dairy Technology or equivalent (B.Sc. in Dairying/Dairy Technology; B.Sc./B.Tech in Food Technology, 4-year degree; B.Sc. Microbial & Food Technology, 4-year degree; B.Tech Bio-Technology)

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group A & Group B Age Limit
content_sections.text: Candidates must not be less than 21 years and not more than 35 years of age as on the last date of receipt of application, 30th September 2026. Age relaxation of up to 5 years for candidates belonging to the Arunachal Pradesh Scheduled Tribe (APST) category. Age relaxation of up to 10 years for candidates belonging to the PwBD category (15 years for APST-PwBD candidates). Age concession for regular State Government employees applies as per prevailing government rules. A one-time upper age relaxation applies for candidates applying for the earlier cancelled examinations (ADO, HDO, VO, and DDO posts), per Government Notification dated 29th June 2026. Date of birth accepted will be as entered in the Matriculation Certificate issued by a recognized Board; no other document (horoscope, affidavit, birth extract, etc.) will be accepted as age proof. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group A & Group B Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates for Group-A posts (Agriculture Development Officer, Horticulture Development Officer, Veterinary Officer, Assistant Director-Sericulture) will be placed in Pay Level 10, carrying a pay scale of ₹56,100–₹1,77,500. The Dairy Development Officer (Group-B) post carries Pay Level 6, ₹35,400–₹1,12,400.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group A & Group B Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on a Written Examination followed by an Interview/Viva-voce, as per the Scheme of Examination notified by the Administrative Reforms Department dated 24th July 2026. General candidates must score an aggregate of 33% of total marks in the written exam, with at least 20% in each paper/subject. PwBD candidates must score an aggregate of 20% of total marks in the written exam, with at least 10% in each paper/subject. Candidates invited for Interview/Viva-voce will be about 3 times the number of advertised vacancies (post/category-wise), or as decided by the Commission. If the number of applicants exceeds the requisite ratio, the Commission will conduct an Objective Type Recruitment Test as a screening stage only - its marks are not counted toward the final merit. Candidates equal to 12 times the advertised posts, based on Recruitment Test performance, will be admitted to the Written Examination.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for APPSC Group A & Group B Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official APPSC website at appsc.gov.in . Complete One Time Registration (OTR) if not already registered; existing OTR users can log in directly with their user ID and password. Fill in the online application form with personal, educational, and eligibility details. Upload the required scanned documents (photo, signature, certificates) as per the prescribed specifications. Pay the application fee of ₹200 online (PwD candidates are exempted). Review all details carefully - no additional time will be given for changes after final submission. Submit the form within the application window (10.09.2026 to 30.09.2026, 5:00 PM). APPSC Apply Online link is active on the official website from 10.09.2026 (5:00 PM) to 30.09.2026 (5:00 PM). Only the application with the highest Registration ID (RID) will be accepted if multiple applications are submitted.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Signature on white paper with black ink pen (scanned, 40–50 KB, JPG). Recent colour passport-size photo, white background, both ears visible, no headgear/sunglasses (scanned, 40–100 KB, JPG). Self-attested photo ID (Aadhaar/Voter ID/PAN/Passport/Driving License or other government-issued photo ID). Self-attested Arunachal Pradesh Scheduled Tribe (APST) Certificate. Self-attested Permanent Resident Certificate (PRC) of Arunachal Pradesh. Self-attested Bachelor's Degree certificate and mark-sheets/mark statements. Self-attested Post Graduate Diploma in Sericulture certificate and mark-sheet (for Assistant Director-Sericulture applicants only). Self-attested registration certificate/record in the Arunachal Pradesh State Veterinary Council (for Veterinary Officer applicants only). Self-attested Matriculation Certificate/Mark-sheet as proof of age. Disability certificate (for PwBD candidates claiming reservation/concession), issued before 30th September 2026. Appointment Order (for government employees seeking age relaxation) and NOC from the Head of Department, where applicable. Candidates with Blindness, Locomotor Disability (Both Arms Affected), or Cerebral Palsy may avail a Scribe by opting for it in the online application; if bringing their own scribe, complete scribe details must be submitted in the prescribed proforma. PwBD candidates of other disability categories opting for a scribe must submit a certificate of physical limitation to write from a Chief Medical Officer/Civil Surgeon/Medical Superintendent of a government healthcare institution. The scribe's qualification must be matriculation or above, but below the minimum qualification required for the post.

faq.question: Q1. What is APPSC Group A & Group B Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a Common Recruitment Examination conducted by the Arunachal Pradesh Public Service Commission under Advertisement No. 04/2026 dated 01.09.2026, to fill 155 Group-A and Group-B Gazetted (Technical) posts across five technical services.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in APPSC Group A & Group B Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 155 posts are advertised: 42 Agriculture Development Officer, 45 Horticulture Development Officer, 66 Veterinary Officer, 1 Assistant Director (Sericulture), and 1 Dairy Development Officer, including 6 posts reserved for PwBD candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for APPSC Group A & Group B Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application window closes on 30th September 2026 at 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for APPSC posts?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post: B.Sc Agriculture (ADO), B.Sc Horticulture (HDO), B.V.Sc & AH with APSVC registration (VO), B.Sc with PG Diploma in Sericulture (Assistant Director-Sericulture), and B.Tech Dairy Technology or equivalent (DDO).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for APPSC Group A & Group B Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 21 and 35 years as on 30th September 2026, with age relaxation of 5 years for APST candidates and up to 10–15 years for PwBD/APST-PwBD candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for APPSC Group A & Group B Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹200, payable online only. PwD candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for APPSC Group A & Group B Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online at appsc.gov.in after completing One Time Registration (OTR), between 10.09.2026 and 30.09.2026 (5:00 PM).

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for APPSC Group A & Group B Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a Written Examination (500 marks: General English & GS, two Concerned Subject papers, and Viva-voce), preceded by a screening Recruitment Test if applications exceed the required ratio.

faq.question: Q9. Is Arunachal Pradesh domicile mandatory for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must hold a valid Permanent Residence Certificate (PRC) of Arunachal Pradesh and an Arunachal Pradesh Scheduled Tribe (APST) Certificate, along with proficiency in an Indigenous Tribal Language.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the APPSC Group A & Group B exam be held?
faq.answer: The Written Examination and Recruitment Test (if conducted) will be held in the Itanagar Capital Region.
